newsitem.title: USA: HP offers new remote PC network software.
newsitem.headline: HP offers new remote PC network software.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co said Monday it was offering its new remote PC network administration software.
The company said its second-generation HP NetServer E Series systems deliver solutions for the self-supported workgroup with little or no IT support, based on Web-based monitoring solutions.
The remote console allows off-site technical experts to dial into the server remotely to diagnose, reboot or reconfigure the system, Hewlett-Packard said.
Computer Associates International Inc offers a similar network administrator system known as CA-Unicenter.
CA shares were off 1-3/4, or almost five percent, to 39-1/2 in midday trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
